name: PassCamp
description_en:
PassCamp currently presents its Vault technology as a customizable B2B password-management system. White-label customers can choose branding, features and infrastructure, while enterprises can integrate it into another software suite or operate it as a standalone tool.

Its public workflow covers saved logins, extension autofill, item permissions and change history. Current commercial scope needs a sales discussion; older assumptions about a personal self-service subscription should not be carried into this record.
description_zh:
PassCamp 当前将 Vault 技术定位为可定制 B2B 密码管理系统。白标客户可选择品牌、功能和基础设施，企业可集成至其他软件套件或作为独立工具运行。

公开流程覆盖登录保存、扩展填充、项目权限及更改历史。当前商业范围需与销售讨论，不能沿用旧的个人自助订阅假设。

sections.title_en: Share an item with explicit permissions
sections.en:
The workflow page describes creating a master password, saving credentials in the web app, optionally installing an extension and adding team contacts. Tags organize records; item permissions, synchronized edits and a history log govern collaboration. The homepage describes an individual vault for each item rather than one indivisible shared container.

For a pilot, use a disposable service login, share it with one test colleague and inspect read/edit behavior plus the recorded change history. Removing vault access does not prove that a recipient forgot a password already viewed or lost an existing external service session. Rotation and external session revocation remain separate operational checks.
sections.zh:
流程页说明创建主密码、在网页应用保存凭据、可选安装扩展、添加团队联系人。标签用于整理记录，项目权限、同步编辑及历史日志用于协作。首页描述每个项目各有保险库，而非一个不可分的共享容器。

试点可用可丢弃服务登录共享给测试同事，核对读写行为及历史记录。移除保险库访问不能证明接收者已忘记看过的密码，或已失去外部现有会话；轮换和外部会话撤销仍需另测。

sections.title_en: Separate the public cloud description from a custom deployment
sections.title_zh: 区分公有云说明与定制部署
sections.en:
The security page describes a Google Cloud deployment in Belgium with daily backups and client-side encryption, while the current homepage advertises Kubernetes-based software that can run on self-hosted instances. These describe different delivery arrangements; neither establishes the region, backup policy or support responsibility of a negotiated enterprise installation.

The vendor describes encryption and per-item history protection, but no security audit was performed here. Before an internal or white-label rollout, agree the key-recovery model, backup restoration, update ownership and data export contract. Mobile offline access is described on the workflow page, but its exact platform and deployment conditions remain untested.
sections.zh:
安全页描述位于比利时的 Google Cloud 部署、每日备份及客户端加密，而当前首页宣传基于 Kubernetes、可自托管的软件。这是不同交付安排，均不能确定定制企业安装的区域、备份政策或支持责任。

厂商说明加密及单项目历史保护，但本文未做安全审计。内部或白标推出前，应约定密钥恢复、备份还原、更新责任及数据导出合同。流程页说明移动离线访问，但具体平台和部署条件未测试。

sections.title_en: Price and rights follow the tailored scope
sections.title_zh: 费用和权益取决于定制范围
sections.en:
The sales page requests contact for a custom quote and provides no numeric tariff. Branding, selected modules, integration, hosting and support must therefore be included in the scope comparison rather than assigned a fictional per-seat price. No ongoing free tier was established by the pages read.

Self-hostable does not automatically mean open source or unrestricted redistribution. The homepage calls the enterprise offering licensed software; this research did not inspect the legal license or a source repository. It also did not verify master-password recovery, restore a backup or execute an import. Shortlist it when a tailored credential product is the task and validate those dependencies in the commercial proof of concept.
sections.zh:
销售页要求联系获取定制报价，没有数字费率。品牌、所选模块、集成、托管及支持因此都应纳入范围比较，不能虚构每席价格。已读页面未确认持续免费套餐。

可自托管不自动等于开源或可无限再分发。首页将企业方案称为获许可软件，本文未查法律许可或源码仓库，也未验证主密码恢复、备份还原或执行导入。任务确需定制凭据产品时可列入候选，并在商业概念验证中核对这些依赖。
